currentRoundInspection.scope: Detached triapsidal Triclinium conservation shelter only. Exact mapped west rectangle and three rounded apses, low stone ruin plinth, glazed exterior proxies between slim frame posts, pale faceted hipped central roof/three radial apse caps, raised roof ribs and diagonal bracing. West entrance has a shallow recess, soffit, threshold and three short reconstructed treads. Main villa/baths, Xystus court, gate piers and two latrines remain independent. Generic interior floor is not a reproduction of figurative mosaics; no copied artwork, furniture or archaeological room inventory.
